objective: Investigate cultivation variability with supporting and contradictory evidence and competing hypotheses; do not assert proven causes.

report.assessment: EXP011/R02 diverged from its paired run EXP011/R01 between elapsed hours 51 and 67: viability fell from 90.78% to 38.47% and ammonium rose from 2.86 to 11.50 mM while R01 held 92.56% viability and 3.26 mM ammonium; VCD then collapsed to 0 by t=148.5h while TCD stayed high. R02's cumulative feed log ends mid-increment at t=67.14h at 11.42 g (R01 held 23.08 g at the same elapsed time and 228.53 g at run end), and R02's glucose record stops at the same ~67h boundary. Gas handling diverged from ~46-48h: R02 dissolved O2 collapsed to ~3-6% despite an O2-enrichment burst (t~51-66h), then CO2 fraction inlet ramped to ~49-52% with dissolved CO2 to 63.85 %-sat, while pH, temperature and agitation stayed tightly controlled in both runs. Inline live-biovolume signals (DeltaEps, Permittivity) corroborate the offline collapse and turbidity stays high, consistent with dead-cell debris at high TCD. What remains unknown: whether feed delivery actually stopped or only its log; whether the gas pattern reflects a deliberate setpoint strategy or a control/equipment problem; whether non-'Ok' Status values other than 'Warning' exist. No cause is asserted. Tool-budget exhaustion prevented in-run calculate_metrics and verify_evidence calls; claimed metric values below are provided for submission-time recomputation.

observed_facts.statement: At t=51.0h (elapsed_hours) the runs are comparable: Viability Mean 92.39% (R01) vs 90.78% (R02); VCD Mean 1.743e6 vs 1.577e6 cells/mL; TCD Mean 1.887e6 vs 1.733e6 cells/mL; Ammonium 2.23 vs 2.86 mM.
At t=67.0h they are separated: Viability Mean 92.56% (R01) vs 38.47% (R02); VCD Mean 3.333e6 vs 1.560e6 cells/mL; Ammonium 3.26 vs 11.50 mM; TCD still similar (3.600e6 vs 4.047e6 cells/mL).
R02 viability continues to fall: 0.7% at t=95.0h and ~0% at t=125.0h; VCD Mean is 0 at t=148.5h and later; R01 viability peaks 95.59% at t=90.5h and declines to 9.47% at t=195.0h.
Ammonium at t=195.0h: R02 48.93 mM vs R01 11.06 mM.
R02 total cell count does not collapse: TCD Mean 5.827e6 cells/mL at t=195.0h (R01 4.753e6) and R02 TCD peak 6.737e6 at t=186.0h exceeds R01's peak 6.317e6.

R02 cumulative feed weight log ends at t=67.139h at 11.42 g (series max 11.43 g at t=67.114h); the last logged rows still increment (11.40, 11.41, 11.42, 11.43), i.e., the record stops mid-delivery rather than at a plateau.
R01 cumulative feed weight was 23.08 g at t=67.140h and R01 had passed 11.42 g already at t=60.413h; R01's full-run total is 228.53 g at t=195.2h.
R02 liquid volume stays near 0.5 L (max 0.5451 L early, last 0.4831 L) while R01 rises to 0.7642 L; R02 osmolality peak 337 mOsmol/kg vs R01 peak 467 mOsmol/kg (source-supplied series statistics).
R02 glucose record stops at t=67.0h (last 0.9945 g/L, n=8 points) while R01 continues to t=148.5h (last 0.1065 g/L, n=13 points).
Dissolved O2: R02 minimum 3.06% air sat (last 10.4%) vs R01 minimum 44.69% (last 95.56%); source-supplied series means 23.81 vs 72.49% air sat.

R02 opened O2 enrichment: Aeration rate O2 maximum 3.613 sL/h and O2 fraction inlet maximum 89.73% occur at the same record; R02's last aeration-rate-O2 value is 0. R01 aeration rate O2 is constant 0 for the whole run (prep flag: constant_series; may be intentional) and R01 O2 fraction inlet peaks at 21.0%.

R02 CO2 fraction inlet peaks at 52.39% and dissolved CO2 at 63.85 %-sat (last 61.58), vs R01 dissolved CO2 peak 16.01 %-sat; source-supplied series means: CO2 fraction inlet 22.58 vs 2.44%, dissolved CO2 29.67 vs 3.89 %-sat.

pH stays in a tight band in both runs: R01 6.958-7.029, R02 7.014-7.066 (peaks cited); temperature peaks 37.055 vs 37.058 C; agitation constant 100 rpm in both (prep flag: constant_series; may be intentional).
Cumulative NaOH: R01 maximum 55.79 g; R02 maximum 1.74 g with the log continuing to t=195.2h (last 1.70 g) - R02 base addition is flat after ~60h while its log does not stop.

Inline live-biovolume signals: DeltaEps peak 29.63 pF/cm (R01) vs 14.05 (R02, occurring in the t=60-72h window, then falling to ~1.5-1.9 average from t=84h per bucketed query aggregates); Permittivity peak 7.99 vs 4.14 pF/cm.

Inline turbidity: R02 Transmission minimum 0.3791 (mean 0.6196) vs R01 maximum 0.9884 (mean 0.9456); R02 Reflection maximum 0.3021 vs R01 0.0911 - R02 stays more turbid/light-blocking from ~t=60h onward.
Structured Status records for this source carry value 'Ok' (example cited); a value_text='Warning' filtered Status search across the whole EXP011 source returned 0 records.

open_questions: Did feed delivery physically stop at ~t=67h in R02, or did only the scale log end? Liquid volume and osmolality are consistent with little delivery but are not mass balance.

What drove R02's DO behavior - a lowered DO setpoint after ~66h, controller saturation, or a probe fault? The 51-66h O2 response shows the loop acted; why enrichment stopped while DO sat at 3-6% is unexplained.
Is the post-72h CO2 ramp a pH-control response to alkaline ammonia load or a programmed strategy? Both fit the observed pH, NaOH and CO2 records.
Do non-'Ok' Status values (Fault/Error/Alarm) exist for EXP011? Unsearched after budget exhaustion.
Why does R02's glucose record stop at t=67h - assay stopped, or depletion/below reporting limit?
Why does R02's pH band (7.014-7.066) sit slightly above R01's (6.958-7.029)?
